edit.old: - Adverbs 已经, 都, 也, 仍, 还 → a `:mod` node on the event they modify. Time adverbs such as 目前 → `:temporal` on that event.
edit.new: - Aspectual and scalar adverbs 已经, 都, 也, 仍, 还 → a `:mod` node on the event they modify. Time adverbs 目前, 曾经, 现在, 当时 → `:temporal` on that event.

edit.anchor: - 其中 → `:mod (其中)` on the noun it introduces, not `:part`.
edit.text: - N1 + V + N2 where N2 (程序, 过程, 制度, 方式, 手续) is the procedure that V names: `N2 :ARG0-of (identity-91 :ARG1 V)`, and N1 is the object of V (`V :ARG1 N1`), with V `:aspect process`. Do not flatten N1 and V into `:mod`s of N2. Other modifiers (一般) stay `:mod` of N2.

Use an English entity type only for a node with `:name`, or for a pronoun. A common-noun mention, even one that refers back to a named entity (该周报, 这家公司), is the Chinese word itself (`周报`) with its `:mod (该)`. Coreference links it to the named mention.

edit.old: Only their temporal triple is left out.
edit.new: Only their temporal triple is left out. Exception: `have-degree-91` gets no `:aspect`, no temporal triple and no modal triple. The property under its `:ARG2` (富-01) carries the aspect, the temporal triple and the modal triple.
- 未经 (*without having undergone*) → `经-01`, `:aspect process`, with no `:polarity -`. Its negation is only the modal triple `(author :full-negative 经-01)`.

edit.old: Every other node with a sense and an `:aspect` gets a parent, normally `(main-event :overlap X)`. This includes an event inside a noun (查证-01) and the property under have-degree-91 (富-01).
edit.new: Every other node with a sense and an `:aspect` gets a parent, normally `(main-event :overlap X)`. This includes the property under have-degree-91 (富-01). An event inside a noun takes as parent the event whose argument contains it (未经…查证程序 → `(经-01 :overlap 查证-01)`), not the sentence's main event.

edit.old: - Anchor each sentence's main event to `document-creation-time` (`:before` if past).
edit.new: - Anchor each sentence's main event to `document-creation-time`. Use `:before` when it is clearly past (了, 过, 曾经, 已经停止). Use `:depends-on` when it is a current state, or a naming or evaluation that still holds (目前…, 被称为, 被誉为).

edit.text: - 以 X 而闻名: the reputation state 闻名 is the parent of the entity's habitual event, `(闻名 :contained 发行)`. 闻名 itself gets no parent.
